notes: OWASP A01/IDOR: both new endpoints go through FunnelService.requireFunnel, which calls ProjectService.requireOwned FIRST then enforces projectId.equals(f.getProjectId()) — a foreign/cross-project funnel id collapses to a uniform 404 before any side effect (duplicate() line 220, stopAllExecutions() line 207). ownerId is resolved from the session via currentUserId() (SecurityContextHolder → AppUserDetails.id()), never from the request body (FunnelController lines 92, 99, 109-115). Tenant isolation for stop-all is correct: the shared cancelInFlightExecutions(projectId, funnelId) helper (FunnelService line 190) scopes updateMulti by BOTH projectId AND funnelId AND status.in(...), matching FunnelExecutionFactory.cancelExistingForPair verbatim; the delete() refactor (line 176) STRENGTHENS the prior scope by adding projectId (previously funnelId-only), so no weakening. IT test stopAllScopedByProjectAndFunnel explicitly proves a sibling-funnel execution (same project) AND a same-funnelId execution under a foreign project are both left running while only the in-scope row is cancelled (cancelled==1). A09-relevant claim-CAS contract (stepRunStatus=done) is asserted via direct field reload. A03/SSRF: no user-controlled URLs introduced; duplicate copies an existing validated step graph verbatim and forces status=draft + trigger reset, never re-running outbound requests. Data exposure: FunnelResponse and StopAllResponse expose no ownerChatId, bot token, or secret — FunnelResponse carries only funnel metadata + deepLink (public t.me link), StopAllResponse only a long count. A05/CSRF: new POST endpoints live under /api/** (session chain @Order(2)) where CSRF is enforced on mutating verbs (CookieCsrfTokenRepository, requireCsrfProtectionMatcher = DEFAULT_CSRF_MATCHER AND not-webhook); the integrations STATELESS chain only matches /api/integrations/** so these endpoints are NOT in the CSRF-disabled namespace. IT tests confirm with .with(csrf()). No hardcoded secrets, no injection (Mongo Criteria are parameterized, no string-concatenated queries), no insecure deserialization. duplicateName truncation is bounded and cannot breach @Size(max=128).
